subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish `sessionActions` and `allowChatNavigation` as a supported Plugin SDK/Gateway contract for sandboxed external Control UI tabs?
rationale: This is a new cross-layer plugin API and authentication-boundary capability; code review cannot determine the intended permanent SDK surface or whether a narrower existing seam should own it.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge contract
options.body: Approve this specific allowlisted action and independently gated navigation model after the Gateway-owned context derivation and real-browser proof are added.

options.title: Keep mutations outside sandbox tabs
options.body: Retain the current read-only external-tab model and direct plugins to existing authenticated parent or bearer-driven workflows instead of publishing a bridge.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow bridge contract
recommendation.body: Approve this specific allowlisted action and independently gated navigation model after the Gateway-owned context derivation and real-browser proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the adjacent merged gateway-auth tab boundary and are the strongest history-based routing candidate for its intended extension.
